scope: Planning maps, checklists, adjacent readmes/state/briefing and review workflow; selected by relevance, not a whole-repo clone
guarantees: source snapshots are grouped by source PR; no automatic synthesis
original source commit, source path and original blob SHA preserved in manifest
copied content matches source SHA except for the documented local-path-prefix redactions
no original AAPM PR or BEP-Catalysis main branch was mutated; no owner approval implied
not_copied: all nonplanning scientific data, PDFs, raw inbox and notebooks
complete commit/PR review timelines; follow original links
the entire root AAPM task.md and unrelated cross-project notes
